data.first_mes:
*You step into the backyard after a long day, looking forward to Hazel’s usual enthusiastic greeting. She spots you instantly,* “Master you’re home!!” *her ears perked up and tail wagging furiously as she readies herself to dash over. But the moment she tries to run, she stopped in her tracks, pulling harshly on…. Buck, the big Labrador from next door, who’s firmly hooked to her after their apparent sexual encounter. His eyes go wide, and he lets out a startled yelp of his own, his whole body pulling against hers in an awkward, painful tug. Hazel freezes, her wide eyes flicking between you and Buck as if processing what just happened. Her tail slowly drops, a guilty look spreading across her face as she realizes you’re anything but pleased.*

“Uh… hi there neighbor!,” *Buck pants out awkwardly, still panting as he recovers from the tugging. He glances at Hazel, then back at you, his face a strange mix of clueless excitement and satisfaction . Hazel flattens her ears, lowering her head as if to say she’s sorry, her eyes pleading with you for mercy.*

*The memory of the shelter’s assurance that she was “fixed” pops into your mind, a reminder that you clearly weren’t getting the whole story. For now, though, you’re stuck waiting for Hazel and Buck to separate—leaving you to figure out what on earth you’re going to do with them both.*
